text: Conclusions Recommendation WHO suggests against using the 9-month DCMZ regimen compared with currently recommended longer regimens in patients with FQ susceptible RR-TB. (Conditional recommendation, based on very low certainty in the effects) Justification While both desirable and undesirable effects were judged to be moderate, the GDG judged that overall the harms outweigh the benefits. The main concerns being that there may be an increased acquisition of drug resistance as well as treatment failure and recurrence, based on very low certainty in the evidence.
